title: Banks Act Directive D12/2025 — Implementation roadmap for the Basel III post-crisis reforms and the Directive on distressed restructured credit exposures
enablingLegislation: Section 6(6)(a) of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990)

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: This directive is issued by the Prudential Authority in terms of Section 6(6)(a) of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990). Implementation roadmap for the Basel III post-crisis reforms and the Directive on distressed restructured credit exposures.

sections.heading: Application
sections.text: This directive applies to all banks, branches of foreign institutions and controlling companies registered or operating in South Africa in terms of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990). Implementation roadmap for the Basel III post-crisis reforms and the Directive on distressed restructured credit exposures.

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: Implementation roadmap for the Basel III post-crisis reforms and the Directive on distressed restructured credit exposures. Institutions are required to ensure compliance with the requirements set out herein. This directive remains effective as confirmed in Banks Act Circular 1 of the relevant year.
